title: Orange and black… must be a warning…
body: I bought the app because it promises to be the best ever!! The graphics  should have been a warning.It is clearly a moneymaking scheme with no insight into real psychology. The courses are presented by the inventer and looks like a zoom meeting!! No extra money spent here. He talks with headphones and microphone to his screen… self praising his own previous ventures… and then…. The app vomits up an overwhelming list of AI generated actions with reminders!!! Hardly anything is free. In app purchases for everything…How you can claim to be better than a great App like fabulous is shocking.!!

title: Great app!
body:
The app is great and gives good guidance on why tracking certain things is important. It’s helping me establish a routine until it becomes second nature. The only issue I have is with the notes section. The text disappears often after I’ve captured there - frustrating as I then need to rewrite or else I just don’t put notes down again for that day. It loses impact a little then due to this problem which I hope the developer can sort out. 
Else it’s really fantastic:)
